proposals.before: Prince Xian of Huaiyang, Qin, was established in the third year of Yuankang (65 BCE). His mother, Lady Zhang the Honored Lady, enjoyed Emperor Xuan’s favor.
proposals.after: Prince Xian of Huaiyang, Qin, was established in the third year of Yuankang (63 BCE). His mother, Lady Zhang the Honored Lady, enjoyed Emperor Xuan’s favor.
proposals.reason: Yuankang 1 is 65 BCE, so Yuankang 3 is 63 BCE; the parenthetical year is wrong.

decisions.reason: 元康三年 is Yuankang year 3; the era began in 65 BCE, so year 3 is 63 BCE. The parenthetical (65 BCE) wrongly equates year 3 with year 1; the proposed (63 BCE) is correct and otherwise leaves the accurate wording unchanged.
